alerts.name: Situational Awareness LP
alerts.headline: Book liquidated
alerts.detail: Prime brokers issued margin calls on a roughly 4x levered book and the fund sold the bulk of its public equity portfolio to Citadel, cutting assets from over $20B to about $10B. Its private positions were retained, including its Anthropic stake. The holdings below are the last 13F, filed for the quarter ended 2026-03-31, and are no longer held. Since then it has begun redeploying, and the company it was backing has been named: Source Foundry, a stealth chip startup founded by Stanford researchers that is trying to make semiconductor manufacturing cheaper and faster. It added $400M in the week of 2026-08-09, bringing its total in the company to $500M after an initial $100M. Both figures circulate in coverage because they measure different things — the latest tranche and the cumulative stake — so neither contradicts the other. A private position never appears in a 13F, so none of it changes the frozen mark below, which prices the public book that was sold rather than the firm.
